segments.contextBefore: The following example creates a [`Regex`](regex.md) that matches a date formatted with the [`numeric`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/Date/FormatStyle/DateStyle/numeric) style in the `en_US` locale.

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let source = "7/31/2022 Lemon-lime slushie $1.99" let matcher = Regex { Capture { One(.date(.numeric, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US"), timeZone: TimeZone(identifier: "PST")!)) } } guard let match = source.firstMatch(of: matcher) else { return } let date = match.1 // date == Jul 31, 2022 at 12:00 AM PST ```
